messages:
anya: quick heads-up, ran a lightweight speculative decode probe on draft-ozma-56b-q2 (4-bit). small harness, but interesting tradeoffs. results below.

mike: SGTM — what harness? can you paste the run command and a short summary?

anya: ran `light-eval --model draft-ozma-56b-q2 --spec-rate 0.2 --tiling=2 --seq=128` across 2k prompts (constrained instruct set). quick numbers:

```
throughput: 2.08x vs baseline (non-spec, same quant)
median latency: 0.58x
auto-bleu-ish proxy: -0.9 pts
perplexity (held): +2.3%
winrate in pairwise auto-compare: 0.48
```

(so speed uplift but slight quality dip on auto metrics)

sophia: those are tiny deltas on quality, could be noise depending on sampling. did you run with multiple seeds / temp settings?

anya: only default seed + top-p 0.92. plan to run seeds=3 and top-p sweep (0.8, 0.9, 0.95). also noticed more token-level variance on long contexts >512 — speculative sometimes emits slightly shorter generations.

raj: shorter generations could be due to aggressive early accept thresholds in the spec policy. can you share the policy params? maybe tune accept_score_delta or min_tokens. also check KV-cache warmup: spec prefetch may bypass some cache warming behavior.

anya: current policy snippet:

```json
{"accept_delta": 0.12, "min_tokens": 1, "spec_rate": 0.2, "fallback_margin": 1.0}
```

I'll try `accept_delta=0.08` and `min_tokens=3` next. adding KV cache warmup toggle to the harness.

mike: can we run a small canary on the dedicated pool (low traffic) to validate end-to-end latency impact and ensure no regression in chat-rerank tests? I can allocate a slot.

anya: yes please. tagging @deploy-bot to create a canary job. will push the harness + eval summary to the shared drive.

deploy-bot: canary job created: id=canary-23345, pool=dedicated-small, model=draft-ozma-56b-q2, spec_policy=trial-v1. Start ETA ~15m. Logs: https://internal/logs/canary-23345

mike: nice. also add a lightweight regression test to `eval-suite/speculative/regressions` comparing human-eval pass rate on our core 200 prompts. smaller runs first to catch big regressions.

anya: will add tests + seed sweep. plan: 1) quick canary, 2) seeds=3 sweep with top-p grid, 3) human eval 200-pass check. aiming to have preliminary update by EOD tomorrow.

sophia: perfect — thanks. ping when the canary finishes and post the first diff artifact. :thumbsup:
